property_summary: The owner() function must return the actual owner stored in the contract, not a hardcoded zero address, such that a pending ownership transfer correctly updates the owner.
The paused() function always returns false after accepting ownership via acceptOwnership()
Calling paused() always returns false after acceptOwnership() changes the owner.
After acceptOwnership() is called, the contract's paused() will only return false if the owner has never called pause(), otherwise it will return true.
After acceptOwnership() is called and the contract is not paused, paused() returns false.
Calling paused() never returns true after acceptOwnership() is called, regardless of whether the previous owner had paused the contract.
For any tokenId, if getRoyalties(tokenId) returns a non-zero royaltyRecipient, the returned royaltyBPS equals the stored per-token value; otherwise it equals the default constant (500).
For a tokenId that has never had royalties updated, getRoyalties returns royaltyBPS equal to 500.
For any tokenId, the royaltyBPS returned by getRoyalties is either the per-token value (if set) or 500.
After accepting ownership, for any tokenId that has never had royalties updated, getRoyalties returns royaltyBPS equal to 500 (the default).
For any tokenId, getRoyalties returns royaltyBPS equal to the default constant 500 when no per-token royalties have been set.
For any tokenId, if the contract is initialized, the royalty recipient returned by getRoyalties() is never address(1) when no per-token configuration has been set.
When no per-token royalty has been set, the royalty recipient returned by getRoyalties is always the protocol fee destination (the address passed to initialize).

For any tokenId, getRoyalties returns a royalty recipient that is either the default royalty recipient (the protocol fee destination) or a non-zero, non-address(1) recipient when no per-token configuration has been set.
After initialization, getRoyalties always returns the default recipient (the one passed to initialize) for any token without a custom configuration.

After the owner renounces ownership via acceptOwnership(), the getRoyalties function must return the protocol fee destination as the royalty recipient for any token without a custom royalty configuration.
For any tokenId, the per-token royalty configuration from getRoyalties returns correct royaltyBPS and royaltyRecipient when the per-token royaltyRecipient is not address(0).
For any tokenId, if per-token royaltyRecipient is address(0), getRoyalties returns the default (500 BPS, royaltyRecipient) instead of the per-token config.
getRoyalties returns the per-token configuration when per-token royaltyRecipient is not address(0), and returns the default configuration otherwise.
When per-token royaltyRecipient is address(0), getRoyalties returns the default (500 BPS, royaltyRecipient) not the per-token config.
getRoyalties returns a per-token configuration with non-zero recipient when it exists, else returns a default configuration with the initial royaltyRecipient.
After calling acceptOwnership, the royalty BPS for any tokenId should be either 0 (if a custom royalty is set) or the contract's hardcoded default of 500.
After acceptOwnership, calling getRoyalties(any tokenId) returns royaltyBPS either exactly the stored value if set, or exactly 500 as default.
After acceptOwnership, the default royalty BPS for any unconfigured token is 500 in the reference contract.
After acceptOwnership, the default royaltyBPS for any tokenId that has never had its royalties updated is 500.
After acceptOwnership, the default royaltyBPS for any tokenId that has never had its royalties updated is 500.
The default royalty configuration for any token ID always returns royaltyBPS equal to 500.
After any minting and transfer, the owner of the contract should be the original deployer and not be zero.
For a token that has never had its royalties updated, getRoyalties(tokenId) returns a configuration with royaltyBPS equal to 500 (which appears as the default when not yet configured).
For any token ID whose royalties have not been explicitly set, getRoyalties(tokenId).royaltyBPS equals 500.
After calling setContractURI(), the totalSupply() should be zero.
After a non-owner calls acceptOwnership(), ownership does not change to the sender.
After acceptOwnership is called by the pending owner, the owner address remains unchanged.
If the pending owner is not the caller, calling acceptOwnership() reverts.
After acceptOwnership() is called by the current owner, the owner remains unchanged.
After any call to acceptOwnership(), the contract owner never changes from its original value when the caller is not the pending owner.
After acceptOwnership() is called by the pending owner, the owner() must equal the caller, not the zero address.
After acceptOwnership() is called by the pending owner, the owner() must be the original caller, not the zero address.
proxiableUUID() returns the ERC1967 implementation slot constant.
After calling acceptOwnership(), the owner of the contract should be the caller.
balanceOf should return the actual balance after minting.
The balanceOf function returns the actual balance of an account for a given token id after the account receives tokens.
balanceOf returns zero for any account and token id when no tokens have been minted to that account for that token id.
balanceOf returns the correct balance for an account that was just minted tokens.
The balanceOf function returns at least the number of tokens minted to an account for a given token id, as exposed by the public state.
balanceOfBatch returns an array of length equal to accounts.length
The balanceOfBatch function returns an array whose elements correspond to the accounts array, not the ids array.
For a single-element balanceOfBatch call, the returned value equals balanceOf on that same account and id.
balanceOfBatch returns an array where the length equals accounts.length and each element at index i equals balanceOf(accounts[i], ids[i])
For a balanceOfBatch call, the length of the returned array must equal accounts.length, regardless of ids.length.
